lessons: A sufficient evidence union can contain a redundant member. Verify necessity and marginal contribution independently.
A benchmark citation hit does not establish additional answer support.
Recording time is an anchor for interpreting relative expressions; it is not an event date by itself.
A source addressee does not identify the speaker or the owner of a first-person assertion.
Previously approved evidence can lose validity when a later correction is observed.
A bounded exact selector can enforce supplied witness constraints; it cannot certify those constraints or corpus completeness.

selector_extraction.tests: Adapted structural boundary and exhaustive-oracle tests; original capsule-only comparison removed, redundant-witness limitation retained as a regression.
selector_extraction.guarantee: Exact within unions of at most one witness per claim followed by baseline fill, under the declared state/transition caps. Not arbitrary-subset global optimization or a semantic guarantee.

semantic_fixture_scope: semantic_cases.json contains synthetic known regression specifications. The structural tests do not establish that HMS or any model solves them.
